data.prompt: I am traveling to Aspen, Colorado for a 3-day ski trip. Please plan what I need to bring. Create one task for clothing and one task for ski equipment.

agents.name: clothing_expert
agents.description: Specialist in clothing, apparel, and wearable items for any trip or activity. Handles tasks about what to wear, pack in terms of garments, footwear, and accessories.

agents.name: gear_expert
agents.description: Specialist in equipment, tools, and sports gear. Handles tasks about physical equipment, technical gear, and any non-clothing items needed for an activity.

config.system_message: Read the user's trip request and break it down into exactly the specialized tasks requested. Every task MUST have 'completed' set to false.
